notes: Phanpy's notification view: everything sits in a narrow centered column on light grey #f0f2f5. Notifications are grouped per target post ('11 people boosted & liked your post.') with a row of gradient circular initials avatars, each carrying a tiny white pill showing which reaction (purple rocket = boost, orange heart = like) that person gave, plus a chevron to expand; the target post is quoted below in a thin-outlined rounded box. Left gutter holds a line icon for event type (rocket+heart, person-plus, speech bubble, pencil for edits, bell for subscribed posts). Mentions render as white cards with an amber/orange border; private mentions get a diagonal yellow-stripe texture plus 'PRIVATE MENTION' label. Day headings use bold 'Today' with a lighter weekday. Follow requests use pill buttons: filled royal-blue Accept, outlined orange-red Reject. 'Mentions →' is a pill link shortcut. Announcement is a collapsible details pill with a red megaphone. Embedded polls show progress-bar results. Settings (sliders icon) opens a modal with per-source Accept/Filter selects; menu button opens a two-column navigation dropdown. A hidden Home timeline panel exists in the DOM (collapsed at y=0) and should be ignored.
